# Base Rates

> Before you decide, see what usually happens: graded base rates for life, work and policy choices, and your own forecasting record.

An hourly beat re-reads each entry's source series for new releases and surfaces newer studies; readers' guesses before the reveal measure which base rates surprise most and order the site.

## Live

- [Base Rates](https://base-rates.ultrastable.org/): the running system
- [Health report](https://base-rates.ultrastable.org/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://base-rates.ultrastable.org/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://base-rates.ultrastable.org/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [IDEA.md](IDEA.md): the one file a person writes
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)
